Describe the reader-facing change and the problem ID or section affected.

For mathematical changes, explain the reasoning and assumptions. For new problems,
include types, dependencies, hints, complete solutions, and a check.

Validation performed:

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] Generated LaTeX is current
- [ ] Changed equations and solution controls reviewed in the site
- [ ] Any reused third-party content has compatible licensing and attribution
